transcript.user: If my visa is denied, what gets refunded and how long would it take?
transcript.assistant: If Linh’s visa is denied and the refund request is filed before classes start, the full paid tuition, unused dormitory charges and unactivated insurance are refundable; no separate admission fee was charged on this bill. The family bears the original outgoing bank fee, intermediary wire fees and currency-conversion losses, so the net amount returned is not guaranteed.
